description:
The Bullet is the foundation of P-51—our flagship model built with true moto-inspired DNA and refined through years of real-world riding. Designed to deliver uncompromised performance, comfort, and durability, the Bullet represents everything we believe an electric bike should be.
This latest generation of the Bullet quietly raises the bar with premium upgrades, including Magura brakes, expanded mounting points, a 5-amp quick charger, updated kickstand, and adjustable power delivery. Every detail has been carefully tested and tuned by our team to create a ride that feels confident, planted, and capable across pavement, dirt, and everything in between.
As a fully street-legal Class 2 electric bike, the Bullet offers peace of mind without sacrificing the fun. With fat tires, dialed handling, and instant thumb-throttle power, it delivers the freedom to explore farther, ride harder, and enjoy every mile—no compromises required.

Adjustable Amps: With the new and improved programming we have added an adjustably in the amps which will allow you to turn up to the amps to get more torque out of your motor. Note: You may experience a bit let range when at a higher amp draw.
Suspension: This is the P-51 difference. The Bullet uses an adjustable triple clamp 27-inch KKE front fork and direct mount adjustable rear DNM piggyback coil over. Suspension travel is 200 mm in the front and 140 mm of wheel travel in the rear
Battery: High quality LG 21700 cell 48 volt - 20 AH lithium-ion battery paired with a powerful BMS. The Bullet also comes with a 5 amp quick charger for fast recharge! Riders will get an estimated range 40+ miles on throttle only (varies due to riding style)
Brakes: The Bullet is equipped with the legendary Magura MT5E Quad piston Hydraulic brakes front and rear and 203mm oversize rotors for increased stopping and overall break performance (Not Currently pictured in the listing photo)
Wheels and Tires: The Bullet uses 20 inch x 4 inch Kenda tires for street and dirt performance.
Compliance: This bike does not need to be registered and is Class 2 compliant
